title: verify_tls_server and siblings panic on empty chain
description:
All use-case wrapper functions in pkix-chain (verify_tls_server, verify_tls_client_dns, verify_tls_client_mailbox, verify_smime_signer, verify_smime_recipient, verify_code_signer, verify_time_stamper) index chain[0] unconditionally after verify_chain returns Ok. If chain is empty, verify_chain returns Err(Error::Path(Error::NoTrustedPath)) and the index is never reached. However, the precondition 'chain must not be empty' is not documented on the wrapper functions — only on verify_chain itself. If the validate_path contract were ever relaxed to accept empty chains (e.g. a trust-anchor-only validation path), the unchecked chain[0] index would panic.

verify_ocsp_responder is the one exception: it checks chain.is_empty() explicitly at line 1292.

What goes wrong if this stays as-is: Currently safe only because validate_path rejects empty chains. But the contract relies on an undocumented coupling between verify_chain's empty-chain rejection and the wrappers' unchecked chain[0] access. If validate_path's empty-chain guard were ever removed or relaxed, eight functions would panic.

Locations:
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain/src/lib.rs line 802 (verify_tls_server: chain[0])
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain/src/lib.rs line 888 (verify_tls_client_dns: chain[0])
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain/src/lib.rs line 965 (verify_tls_client_mailbox: chain[0])
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain/src/lib.rs line 1033 (verify_smime_signer: chain[0])
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain/src/lib.rs line 1066 (verify_smime_recipient: chain[0])
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain/src/lib.rs lines 1187-1188 (verify_time_stamper: chain[0])

Suggested fix: Either (a) document the 'chain must not be empty' precondition on each wrapper, or (b) add the same explicit is_empty() guard verify_ocsp_responder already uses.
